name: Fuyou zhi Guo de Qiutu
source:
This is a visual novel that interweaves ancient Chinese sacrificial rites, history, suspense, and horror.

Fourteen from across the world are mysteriously drawn into a sealed "Ephemera Manor" to partake in an ancient ritual dubbed "the Feather-Burning Rite".

The dead rise; the living stray. A bloodstained drama spanning millennia has silently unfolded...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3880360/]Steam[/url]]
